protocol.adaptive: Least q with rho/(lambda||p||²)*B_q(p)<=tol||b||/(4maxiter); ordinary PCG recurrence, actual |alpha|B accumulated.
protocol.fixed_stop: Recursive norm<=.5tol||b||, then original-A verify. No restart/replacement after failed verification.
protocol.adaptive_stop: Recursive norm+actual accumulated bound<=tol||b||, then original-A verify.
protocol.reference_checks: Stopping candidate and final on any cap/failure only; no exact residual feedback during adaptive iterations.
protocol.free_diagnostic_resources: Dense Gaussian, dense Taylor matrices and all-degree roots cache; FPS64 Nyström setup copied from replay. Not a1MiB or native solver measurement.
protocol.weights: Only matched case/shift replay medians for available degrees. Missing prices remain null.

post_run_summary.interpretation: Actual recurrence converges in these six cases, but adaptive mean degree is close to replay-static degree. Fewer iterations partly reflect prescribed different stopping thresholds (adaptive residual+bound<=tol versus fixed recursive residual<=tol/2). Missing adaptive-degree timings prevent complete action-cost comparisons. Analytic truncation bounds do not include roundoff; observed residual gaps can exceed their sums, so final original-system verification remains essential. No native memory or end-to-end speed claim.
